functions.name: HasValidTangents
GetTangentFrame
functions.signature: GetTangentFrame(Target, Triangle ID, Tri Vertex Index, Normal Out, Tangent Out, Bitangent Out)
functions.docs: If tangents are available in the overlays, returns them. If only Normal is available, computes orthogonal basis. Falls back to unit axes if no overlays are available.

functions.name: GetTangentVectors
functions.signature: GetTangentVectors(Target, Triangle ID, Tri Vertex Index, Normal, Tangent Out, Bitangent Out)
functions.docs: If tangents are available in the overlays, returns them. Otherwise computes orthogonal basis to Normal argument.

functions.name: GetTangentVectors
functions.signature: GetTangentVectors(Target, Triangle ID, Tri Vertex Index, Tangent Out, Bitangent Out)
functions.docs: If tangents are available in the overlays, returns them, otherwise falls back to unit X/Y axes.

functions.name: CopyTriVertexTangents
functions.docs:
Initialize Tangents from the FDynamicMeshAttributeSet of SourceMesh
@return false if tangent attributes do not exist

functions.name: ComputeTriVertexTangents
functions.signature: ComputeTriVertexTangents(Target, Normal Overlay, UV Overlay, Options)
functions.docs:
Calculate per-triangle tangent spaces based on the given per-triangle normal and UV overlays.
In this mode there is no averaging of tangents across triangles. So if we have N triangles
in the mesh, then 3*N tangents are generated. These tangents are computed in parallel.

functions.name: ComputeTriangleTangents
functions.docs:
Compute per-triangle tangents for the given UV Overlay
@param bOrthogonalize if true, we orthogonalize the tangents by computing the Bitangent sign and regenerating it. Otherwise the tangents are left non-orthogonal.

functions.name: CopyToOverlays
functions.docs:
Set Tangents on mesh overlays
@param MeshToSet Mesh to copy overlays to; does not need to be the same as the Mesh member of this class

functions.name: SetTangentCount
functions.docs: Set the size of the Tangents array to Count, and optionally clear all values to (0,0,0)
